title: iPhone 18 Pro event date: When Apple announced its event over the last six years
summary: The pandemic disrupted Apple’s regular iPhone event schedule in 2020 and 2021. Apple is expected to unveil three new flagship iPhones: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and its first foldable iPhone, possibly called iPhone Ultra.
